notes.title: Rome Goes Rogue Difficulty Update 1.4
notes.content:
This update adds a new Difficulty tab which lets you select three different settings!  If you keep losing the fight against Rome Goes Rogue, then this update has a new Wuss Mode which is much more accessible!  There's also a Hard Mode too, if you're interested.

Additions
-----------
- Two new difficulty settings, Wuss Mode, Normal Mode and Hard Mode!
- A New ending if you beaten the game on Wuss Mode
- An FPS Counter in the Settings

Changes
-----------
- This is Totally Cereal no longer relies on small velocity to spawn, but instead connected to a small timer
- ...Same goes for Teacher's Little Rat

Fixes
-----------
- Minor fixes

notes.title: Rome Goes Rogue Quality of Life Update 1.3
notes.content:
Additions
-----------
- You can now use T to open a new Transport menu to fast travel to any station in the Hub World
- Added a Quick Restart button in the Game Over screen
- You can now skip the Game Over screen
- Added a Timer option in the Settings
- Added new animations in the Hub World
- You can now quick restart a run by pressing Ctrl + R

Changes
-----------
- Changed the size of the buttons in the settings to be smaller
- Removed the card animations in the elevator due to it causing issues, sorry!

Fixed
-----------
- HEAVILY polished the Uppercut move
- Minor fixes

notes.title: Rome Goes Rogue Halloween-ish Update v1.2
notes.content:
This tiny Halloween special adds new spoopy themed upgrades and abilities with other additions, QOL changes and bug fixes! Also, the weird screen bug should be 10000000000% fixed now!

Additions
------------
- Added 5 new spooky cards that are very different from each other that unlocks if you complete a certain quest
- New structure in the Hub World which is a sketchy van featuring The Candy Dealer!
- A New side quest where you need to collect 10 pumpkins for The Candy Dealer
- A Reset Data button in the Main Menu
- New stuff in the Main Menu

Changes
------------
- Rome's ragdoll is faster to control
- Trains are slower and should be easier to dodge them

Fixes
------------
- Fixed the weird screen bug
- Fixed some Z Elevation issues in the Editor
- Game no longer gets stuck in slow motion if you exit the level with the Hourglass still active
- Fixed some sprite issues
- Fixed other things that I forgot

notes.title: Minor update + Patch Notes
notes.content:
This update fixes issue with the pause menu, death screen, and others that some people were experiencing.  Also added some other small things too

Additions
-----------
- Added a reset button in the Mutators tab
- Mutators and stat changes are now compatible with the Editor
- Added new effects

Fixes
-----------
- Fixed issues with the pause screen
- Fixed game over screen
- Fixed some Z Elevation issues in the Editor

Changes
-----------
Changed pause screen
Changed Custom Game buttons to be smaller
